paragraphs.text: People receive degrees according to what they have done. Allah fully compensates everyone, and no one is wronged. Those exposed to the Fire are told that they used their worldly pleasures and are punished for arrogance and disobedience. The brother of Aad warned his people to worship Allah alone and feared a terrible day for them. They mocked his warning and demanded what he promised. He said knowledge of its time belongs only to Allah, while he had delivered his message. When they mistook an approaching cloud for rain, it was the painful wind they had challenged. By its Lord's command, it destroyed everything until only their homes remained. Aad had been given hearing, sight, and hearts, but these did not help them when they rejected Allah's signs. Nearby cities were also destroyed, yet their supposed deities could not help them. The people had strayed from those deities, and their claims were inventions. Their worldly enjoyment does not protect them from that humiliation. Their warning had come from a messenger, but they asked whether he would delude them away from their gods. They were impatient for the punishment they had been warned about. They behaved ignorantly when he explained that its timing was known only to Allah.

A few jinn listened quietly when they heard the Qur'an. Afterward, they returned to their people as warners. They said that the revealed Book confirmed what came before it and guided to truth and a straight path. They called their people to respond to Allah's Messenger, believe in him, and seek forgiveness and protection from painful punishment. Whoever refuses the Caller cannot escape Allah or find another protector. The passage asks whether the Creator of the heavens and earth can give life to the dead, and answers that He can. Those who denied the truth will acknowledge it when facing the Fire. The Messenger is told to be patient like the messengers of determination and not to hurry. When the promised day comes, worldly time will seem like only an hour. Only defiantly disobedient people will be destroyed.
